meaning: Identifier of one canonical Page3 fact.
caution: Unique in this release; do not substitute record_id as a fact key.

meaning: Original Page3 source PDF filename.
caution: Resolve through the source inventory or raw page3 folder; filename alone is not byte identity.

meaning: SHA-256 of the source PDF.
caution: Use with source_file and evidence_id to trace the original document.

meaning: Date assigned to the source bulletin.
caution: Same-bulletin equality join key; not proof of publication time or forecast availability.

meaning: Stored date intended to describe the measurement temporal support.
caution: All values equal bulletin_date here, contrary to parts of the contract; do not use as a validated hydrological date.

meaning: Source table family T1 stock, T2 selected dams, T3 inflow, T4 withdrawal, T5 transfers, T6 Ichkeul.
caution: Family alone does not identify grain, measure, or accounting role.

meaning: Entity and observation scope of the fact.
caution: Seven distinct grains; never combine a regional total, dam measurement and route as equivalent rows.

meaning: Imported type/class of the entity represented by the fact.
caution: Interpret together with grain and entity_id.

meaning: Canonical identifier of nation, region, dam, row slot, route or other observation entity.
caution: Not every identifier denotes a dam; provisional El Hma is excluded from confirmed dam joins.

meaning: Arabic label associated with this entity or source row.
example_or_all_codes: ["المعدل لنفس اليوم للثلاث السنوات الفارطة", "لهذا اليوم من الموسم الحالي", "الفارق"]
caution: A display/source interpretation label; not an approved join key.

meaning: English interpretation of the entity or source row label.
example_or_all_codes: ["average for the same day over the last three years", "this day of the current season", "difference"]
caution: Read grain and measure before treating it as a scientific definition.

meaning: Recorded origin node for applicable transfer records.
caution: Meaning depends on physical versus accounting grain; blank is not zero flow.

meaning: Recorded destination node for applicable transfer records.
caution: External Ichkeul delivery and internal dam destinations must remain distinct.

meaning: Imported semantic role of the source row.
caution: Distinguishes physical transfer edges from accounting observations; not all rows are additive.

meaning: Source row-slot reference where applicable.
caution: Position is not a dam identity; unresolved T2 rows remain anonymous.

meaning: Canonical region identifier where applicable.
caution: Does not establish time-varying dam membership in a P3 regional total.

meaning: Canonical analysis measure name.
caution: Not unique across all grains or sufficient alone as a key; use the measure dictionary.

meaning: Parsed or recovered numeric source fact, when available.
caution: Unit comes from unit/measure; null is not zero and values are not corrected by interpage matching.

meaning: Stored unit token for the fact.
caution: mm3 means Mm3, million cubic metres, in this dataset; pct means a reported percentage, not a 0-1 fraction. Subtracting percentages gives a difference in percentage points.

meaning: Recorded state of the numeric/textual source value.
caution: Distinguish PRESENT_ZERO, SOURCE_BLANK, PRESENT_TEXT, WITHHELD_UNRESOLVED and STRUCTURAL_NOT_EXPECTED.

meaning: Imported result of source entity/roster identification.
caution: IDENTITY_NOT_APPLICABLE is appropriate for many non-dam facts; unresolved and provisional states do not authorize a dam join.

meaning: String flag indicating provisional identity.
caution: Stored TRUE/FALSE strings, not native booleans; TRUE prohibits confirmed dam integration.

meaning: Imported within-source consistency/arithmetic assessment.
caution: Not the new interpage equality result; SOURCE_CONSISTENT does not prove agreement with P1/P2 or physical truth.

meaning: Imported continuity/observation state for the fact series.
caution: The fact table is not a complete calendar panel; absence of gap rows does not prove uninterrupted coverage.

meaning: Reserved/imported schema-era annotation.
caution: Entirely empty in the current fact release; do not infer absence of schema changes.

meaning: Imported aggregate quality annotation.
caution: A source pipeline tag, not a universal clean-data or training-admission decision; inspect component flags and contracts.

meaning: Imported overall usability annotation.
caution: OK/PARTIAL do not override unresolved identity, date support or leakage restrictions.

meaning: Recorded extraction recovery method where populated.
caution: Blank does not independently prove no processing occurred; trace evidence and upstream recovery reports.

meaning: Identifier of the upstream source-cell evidence.
caution: Useful for raw token/cell traceability; detailed evidence may remain in the original extraction run.

meaning: Identifier of the upstream Page3 extraction release.
caution: Distinct from the newer interpage diagnostic run IDs.

meaning: Version label of the Page3 extractor producing the record.
caution: Version identity does not by itself prove every cell was audited visually.

meaning: Imported continuity-series identifier.
caution: Contract joins the continuity ledger by series_id and bulletin_date; do not parse identity from its text as a substitute for recorded keys.

meaning: Stable scientific source-field identity from the frozen semantic registry.
caution: 22 fields map to multiple analysis measure/grain combinations; field identity alone does not collapse grain.

meaning: Identifier of the upstream source table record.
caution: One source record can supply several measures; this is not unique per numeric fact.

meaning: Stored label describing how effective_observation_date was assigned.
caution: All SAME_DAY here; this conflicts with the contract for daily flows and non-day comparators.

meaning: Retained source numeric/text token for the fact.
caution: Not the entire PDF cell evidence; accept displayed precision only when the token reproduces value.

meaning: Imported link to a gap episode when populated.
caution: Entirely empty in current facts; use the separate continuity evidence to investigate gaps.

meaning: Page1/2-compatible dam identifier supplied by the audited crosswalk.
caution: Use only at confirmed dam grain; provisional or empty identifiers must not become joins.

meaning: String flag indicating confirmed P1/2 dam identity.
caution: TRUE is required with DAM_DAY and non-provisional identity; FALSE is expected for non-dam grains.
